39755-the-story-of-peter-pan-retold-from.creator: Unknown
39755-the-story-of-peter-pan-retold-from.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. ohn Napoleon, and Wendy Moira Angela, and Michael, the children of Mr. The nursery was wide and airy, with a large window, and a bright fire with a high fire-guard round it, and a big clock, and prettily-coloured nursery-rhyme pictures over the walls. It was in many ways a most interesting household.

arxiv-1910-06073.title: OPEN SOURCE AND SUSTAINABILITY: THE ROLE OF UNIVERSITY
arxiv-1910-06073.creator: Dr. Giorgio F. SIGNORINI, PhD
arxiv-1910-06073.description: Abstract One important goal in sustainability is making technologies available to the maximum possible number of individuals, and especially to those living in less developed areas (Goal 9 of SDG). However, the diffusion of technical knowledge is hindered by a number of factors, among which the Intellectual Property Rights (IPR) system plays a primary role.

arxiv-2201-12560.title: Sim-to-Real for Soft Robots using Differentiable FEM: Recipes for Meshing, Damping, and Actuation
arxiv-2201-12560.creator: Mathieu Dubied, Mike Y. Michelis, Andrew Spielberg, Robert K. Katzschmann
arxiv-2201-12560.description: Abstract An accurate, physically-based, and differentiable model of soft robots can unlock downstream applications in optimal control. The Finite Element Method (FEM) is an expressive approach for modeling highly deformable structures such as dynamic, elastomeric soft robots. In this paper, we compare virtual robot models simulated using differentiable FEM with measurements from their physical counterparts.

arxiv-2401-13873.title: Heat kernel estimates for kinetic SDEs with drifts being unbounded and in Kato’s class Thanks: Keywords: Kinetic SDEs, Kato’s class, Krylov’s estimate, Heat kernel eatimates Thanks: This work is partially supported by NNSFC grants of China (Nos. 12131019), and the German Research Foundation (DFG) th
arxiv-2401-13873.creator: Chongyang Ren and Xicheng Zhang
arxiv-2401-13873.description: Abstract . In this paper we investigate the existence and uniqueness of weak solutions for kinetic stochastic differential equations with Hölder diffusion and unbounded singular drifts in Kato’s class. Moreover, we also establish sharp two-sided estimates for the density of the solution.

arxiv-2410-07409.title: Learning responsibility allocations for multi-agent interactions: A differentiable optimization approach with control barrier functions
arxiv-2410-07409.creator: Isaac Remy, David Fridovich-Keil, Karen Leung
arxiv-2410-07409.description: Abstract From autonomous driving to package delivery, ensuring safe yet efficient multi-agent interaction is challenging as the interaction dynamics are influenced by hard-to-model factors such as social norms and contextual cues. Understanding these influences can aid in the design and evaluation of socially-aware autonomous agents whose behaviors are aligned with human values.

arxiv-2504-00752.title: LLMs4SchemaDiscovery: A Human-in-the-Loop Workflow for Scientific Schema Mining with Large Language Models
arxiv-2504-00752.creator: Sameer Sadruddin, Jennifer D’Souza ∗, Eleni Poupaki, Alex Watkins, Hamed Babaei Giglou, Anisa Rula, Bora Karasulu, Sören Auer, Adrie Mackus, Erwin Kessels
arxiv-2504-00752.description: Abstract Extracting structured information from unstructured text is crucial for modeling real-world processes, but traditional schema mining relies on semi-structured data, limiting scalability. This paper introduces schema-miner , a novel tool that combines large language models with human feedback to automate and refine schema extraction.

arxiv-2509-22160.title: List coloring ordered graphs with forbidden induced subgraphs
arxiv-2509-22160.creator: Marta Piecyk, Paweł Rzążewski
arxiv-2509-22160.description: Abstract In the List k k -Coloring problem we are given a graph whose every vertex is equipped with a list, which is a subset of { 1 , … , k } \{1,\ldots,k\} . We need to decide if G G admits a proper coloring, where every vertex receives a color from its list.

arxiv-2509-25374.title: Saliency Guided Longitudinal Medical Visual Question Answering
arxiv-2509-25374.creator: Jialin Wu, Xiaofeng Liu
arxiv-2509-25374.description: Abstract Longitudinal medical visual question answering (Diff-VQA) requires comparing paired studies from different time points and answering questions about clinically meaningful changes. In this setting, the difference signal and the consistency of visual focus across time are more informative than absolute single-image findings. We propose a saliency-guided encoder–decoder for chest X-ray Diff-VQA that turns post-hoc saliency into actionable supervision.

arxiv-2601-11378.title: Transmon Architecture for Emission and Detection of Single Microwave Photons
arxiv-2601-11378.creator: Daniel L. Campbell, Stephen McCoy, Melinda Andrews, Alexander Madden, Viva R. Horowitz, Bakir Husremović, Samuel Marash, Christopher Nadeau, Man Nguyen, Michael Senatore, Samuel Schwab, Erin Sheridan, Matthew D. LaHaye
arxiv-2601-11378.description: Abstract We showcase the recently developed double transmon coupler (DTC) circuit as a compact, drop-in, tunable and transition-selective link between an otherwise coherent transmon and the continuum of modes in a waveguide. We use these transmon-DTC devices as transmon emitter/dectectors (TEDs) for microwave photons.

arxiv-2602-15957.title: Evolutionary Systems Thinking From Equilibrium Models to Open-Ended Adaptive Dynamics
arxiv-2602-15957.creator: Dan Adler
arxiv-2602-15957.description: Abstract Complex change is often described as “evolutionary” in economics, policy, and technology, yet most system dynamics models remain constrained to fixed state spaces and equilibrium-seeking behavior. This paper argues that evolutionary dynamics should be treated as a core system-thinking problem rather than as a biological metaphor.

pmc-10537828.title: Association between psychosocial work-related factors at midlife and arterial stiffness at older age in a prospective cohort of 1736 white-collar workers
pmc-10537828.creator: Victoria K Massamba, Denis Talbot, Alain Milot, Xavier Trudel, Clermont E Dionne, Michel Vézina, Benoit Mâsse, Mahée Gilbert-Ouimet, Gilles R Dagenais, Neil Pearce, Chantal Brisson
pmc-10537828.description: ObjectiveArterial stiffness and exposure to psychosocial work-related factors increase the risk of developing cardiovascular disease. However, little is known about the relationship between psychosocial work-related factors and arterial stiffness. We aimed to examine this relationship.DesignProspective cohort study.SettingPublic organisations in Quebec City, Canada.ParticipantsThe study included 1736 white-collar workers (women 52%) from 19 public organisations.

pmc-10627882.title: Unilateral optogenetic kindling of hippocampus leads to more severe impairments of the inhibitory signaling in the contralateral hippocampus
pmc-10627882.creator: Fabio Cesar Tescarollo, Daniel Valdivia, Spencer Chen, Hai Sun
pmc-10627882.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). The kindling model has been used extensively by researchers to study the neurobiology of temporal lobe epilepsy (TLE) due to its capacity to induce intensification of seizures by the progressive recruitment of additional neuronal clusters into epileptogenic networks. We applied repetitive focal optogenetic activation of putative excitatory neurons in the dorsal CA1 area of the hippocampus of mice to investigate the role of inhibitory signaling during this process.

pmc-10683484.title: Modern Alchemical Free Energy Methods for Drug Discovery Explained
pmc-10683484.creator: Darrin M York
pmc-10683484.description: This Perspective provides a contextual explanation of the current state-of-the-art alchemical free energy methods and their role in drug discovery as well as highlights select emerging technologies. The narrative attempts to answer basic questions about what goes on “under the hood” in free energy simulations and provide general guidelines for how to run simulations and analyze the results.

pmc-10725645.title: The Associations Between Serum Vitamins and Carotenoids with Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease: Results from the NHANES
pmc-10725645.creator: Lei Zheng, Xiaofei Yu, Zehai Xia, Yehao Guo, Yifan Dai
pmc-10725645.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). PurposeVitamins and carotenoids are essential in preventing and treating chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD). pmc-11316541.title: Bibliometric analysis of scientific production in occupational health nursing
pmc-11316541.creator: Miguel Valencia-Contrera, Flérida Rivera-Rojas
pmc-11316541.description: Occupational health nursing, formerly known as industrial nursing, which in turn has its foundations in public health, develops preventive, assistance, legal, and expert activities, as well as management, teaching, and research, the last of which updates knowledge and provides answers to questions arising from clinical experience.

pmc-11860682.title: Diagnostic Challenges in Affective Disorders: Delirious Mania - A Case Report and Literature Review.
pmc-11860682.creator: P Herrero Ortega, A Oliva Lozano, J Garde González, M A Morillas Romerosa
pmc-11860682.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). IntroductionAffective disorders exhibit diverse clinical manifestations, and one distinctive subtype is delirious mania. Despite its exclusion from formal diagnostic manuals, delirious mania frequently emerges in everyday clinical practice. Recognizing it within the realm of differential diagnosis is crucial. Delirious mania is characterized by acute onset of excitement, grandiosity, emotional lability, delusions, and insomnia typical of mania, combined with disorientation and altered consciousness characteristic of delirium.

pmc-12534917.title: Anthelmintic resistance in livestock in Africa: review of the current status
pmc-12534917.creator: Lucy Gatitu, Mitchelle R. Kasudi, Samuel Githigia, Arshnee Moodley, Dishon M. Muloi
pmc-12534917.description: BackgroundLivestock across the globe are frequently infected with multiple gastrointestinal nematode (GIN) species, and the use of anthelmintics remains a cornerstone of their control. However, anthelmintic resistance (AHR) poses a growing threat to sustainable livestock production, resulting in reduced productivity and compromised animal health and welfare.

pmc-12719639.title: Construction and Evaluation of Nomogram Prediction Model for Urinary Tract Infection After Transurethral Bipolar Plasmakinetic Prostatectomy
pmc-12719639.creator: Pengfei Diao, Suquan Zhong, Dong Chen, Hangtao Wang, Yiying Zheng, Jinhua Wang, Chao Tian
pmc-12719639.description: ObjectiveTo explore the risk factors of urinary tract infection after transurethral bipolar plasmakinetic prostatectomy (TUPKP) in patients with prostatic hyperplasia (BPH), to construct a nomogram model for predicting postoperative urinary tract infection, and evaluate the differentiation and consistency of the model.

pmc-12926437.title: HBV genotype distribution and S gene mutations in HIV-HBV co-infected patients: insights from North India
pmc-12926437.creator: Hiba Sami, Mohd Asaad, Syed Haider Mehdi Husaini, Parvez Anwar Khan, Adil Raza, Nazish Fatima, Haris M. Khan
pmc-12926437.description: PurposeEffective HBV therapy and immunisation require knowledge of HBV mutation rate and genetic variability. This study aimed to characterize HBV genotypes, serotypes, and surface (S) gene mutations among HBV–HIV co-infected and HBV mono-infected patients in North India.MethodsA total of 100 HBV–HIV co-infected and 50 HBV mono-infected patients were enrolled.

pmc-12948051.title: A comparison of microbial community composition in two alpine springs in southern Nevada
pmc-12948051.creator: Shawna Hunnicutt, El Hachemi Bouali, Bryan Sigel, Renjith VishnuRadhan, Renjith VishnuRadhan, Renjith VishnuRadhan, Renjith VishnuRadhan
pmc-12948051.description: Springs are intersections between the geosphere and hydrosphere where localized ecosystems form. Microbial communities play important roles in these aquatic ecosystems and can be identified using environmental DNA (eDNA) acquisition and amplification techniques. The Spring Mountain range west of Las Vegas, Nevada is a sky island with over 300 naturally flowing cold water springs.

pmc-13051305.title: Determining ED50 of Nalbuphine for Intraoperative Analgesia in Elderly Patients Undergoing Percutaneous Kyphoplasty: A Prospective, Double-Blind, Single-Center, Dose-Finding Study
pmc-13051305.creator: Peng Zhao, Xin Song, Yu Liu, Ying Luo, Zhiyong Cui, Yanyang Guo, Xin Wang, Jingjing Yang, Huipeng Zhou
pmc-13051305.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundNalbuphine is a novel intravenous anesthetic. Studies have shown that it features a rapid onset of action, a fast recovery time, slight inhibition of respiratory and cardiovascular functions, and a low incidence of adverse reactions.

pmc-13275679.title: Formononetin: a promising therapeutic agent targeting the gut-lung axis in acute lung injury
pmc-13275679.creator: Wuliji Batu, Daijian Liu, Chunxiu Ren, Wenhui Bi, Junmei Wang, Yu Wang
pmc-13275679.description: BackgroundAcute lung injury (ALI) is a common acute inflammatory lung disease in critical clinical conditions, with a complex pathogenesis and limited available treatment options. Although the gut-lung axis has been identified as an emerging field of host-related microbiota in various chronic lung diseases, it remains unclear whether gut microbiota is associated with the development and progression of ALI.

pmc-13659978.creator: Bemnet Fekre Butta, Natnael Atle Benti, Bethelhem Tamiru Tasew, Bemnet Yacobe Sayid, Huda Mohammed Fetwi
pmc-13659978.description: BackgroundWorkplace violence has emerged as a global problem that affects all nations, workplaces, and occupational categories. The health sector accounts for more than one-third of all workplace violence worldwide. There is very little information available in Ethiopia about workplace violence affecting healthcare professionals.
